crossRefs.note: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
translations.bsb: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your dwellings, O Israel!
translations.kjv: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
